notes.title: Patch - V 1.2.1
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience as the following bugs were addressed.

- Slight adjustment to digging
- Added animation for holding a tool
- Fixed first day bug where Manager got stuck
- Fixed fountain loop noise.
- Right side of pause menu always activates now at the same time as the left
- Added experimental camera views when in main menu

notes.title: V 1.2.0
notes.content:
- Digging has been improved with accuracy
- Metal Detector updated with accuracy
- Plus and minus with no numbers to avoid confusing values
- Achievements in game have numbers now to track progress
- The Manager now has a stable routine/ no more random checkpoints
- Privacy Policy is now located only at www.zayniacgames.com
